text:
We got lucky! 
Well, an expensive lucky, and also very scary process.
In January 2025 we were invited for the 2nd A5 annual interview (separated interviews - me and the PIBA and then my partner and PIBA) . We were told we'll get the repy within 3 months and we got a temp A5 for 3 months.
After 3 months.. we didn't get a reply and got another 3 months A5.
Then in July 2025, we got the call to "come for the office" we came, we gave the passport and got a letter.. and while we were reading the letter,.. the lady at the counter puts **"CANCELLED"  **stamps on all previous visa.
We had 21 days to find a lawyer,. pass them all the collected data/info/history and  submit an appeal (which we did in time), it was of course ignored by the internal process and after 3 months, we had to appeal to the "Beit Din Le Ararim" .
Finally on Sunday (a YEAR after the deportation letter and the cancelled visa), we had the actual court date (well, its a דיון infront of a דיין, not a judge, but same looks and feels).

We came with heavy heart, as the Dayan, is a political appointment and is personally selected by the Minister of Justice (Yariv Levin) who himself is against mixers.

So we already expected the bias and predjuice to work against us.

To our biggest surprise, the Dayan, behaved incredibly in the most humanistic way. He saw immediatly through the fake reasons of the PIBA (they litterally lied on so many things... I still cannot belive it until now that a real gov't office will write lies, black on white on an official letter).

What lies?

We don't have shared friends
We NEVER (not just in recent year) left Israel together
We do not participate in family events

Every year (4 years of B1 plus 2 years of A5) we submit around 60 pics of events with friends and family 
We submit letters from 4-5 friends and family.

So,. when we last travelled together to Paris and to  Kyiv 4 years ago, not only we travelled togethe,. we even met our friends (who "we do not have") in Kyiv and of course its all documented.
And about family events?   Every Rosh Hashana, Every Leil Haseder, Every Hanuka, and birhdays of my mother and my father are heavily  captured with pics of us, my parents, my uncle/cousins.

But, remember their arguments to say that we do not have a true relationship!

We got lucky!!

The Dayan was a real Mentch !! and was very sincere and honest.
Kudos to him,. really !!

He scolded the PIBA lawyer for their actions and "I strongly suggest you take my suggestion to your bosses".

and below, you have the actual verdict and actions that will now be taken.

We were sure we will have to go to the distric court, but we got lucky.  It took exactly one year (where my partner could not leave Israel, did not have any work, no insurance of any kind - of course not Kupat Cholim - a deportation process hanging above our heads and ... out lives !!! we are living in Israel together already 8 years !!.. and they want to separate us (we are not married).

Bellow,. the final verdict of the session with the Dayan.
